body:
It was the Friday after thanksgiving and my two friends, mike and mike, decide to smoke a 1/2 ounce in honor of thanksgiving.  I decided that I wanted to do something else too besides weed (weed is a gateway drug for me).  I downed 8 grams of nasty nutmeg and my friend did the same.  I've done it a couple of times with all right results but nothing I'd compare to mushrooms or lsd. I should also mention that I had a 101 fever.  We smoked all day and around 2 o'clock I felt the nutmeg kick in.  It was a nice body high and I was enjoying it.
Later on that night, at around 10 o'clock, I went to the kitchen to grab some tylenol and all of a sudden I got dizzy.  Then I got real dizzy.  Everything was just coming at me.  It happened so fast that I dropped the tylenol and just stood in horror as everything spun faster and faster.  I mumbled to my girlfriend to grab the bottle but she couldn't understand what I was saying and had no idea what was going on.  I ran upstairs.  My girlfriend described the way I went up the stairs as though I was very drunk.  I ran into my room and tripped on my shoes and land on bed.  My heart was pounding and I was just plain scared.  I stared up and just thought about my life.  The dizzyness went away and I slowly became calm.
It was very scary.  I don't know if it was to much nutmeg or me just being sick.  I'll do nutmeg again, but this time I'll know that stuff like this can and will happen.
